# Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Selskab i Danmark

Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Selskab i Danmark is a Danish professional society (fagselskab) named as a member of the steering group for the ADHD-databasen, a Danish health-quality registry that monitors the diagnosis and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2]. The database's steering group draws together senior physicians, specialists, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relatives' representatives from across Denmark, alongside representatives of all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut [^src2]. The society is documented in this capacity across two annual editions of the underlying source material — the 2023 report [^src1] and the 2024 report [^src2] — but no further details about its activities, leadership, or history are given in the corpus. No relationships, claims, or timeline entries beyond its listed membership are recorded.
